svg.aria-label: Animated diagram: eight healthcare data sources streaming into a dimensional human figure that represents a women's health digital twin, which outputs twin state and a decision.
svg.title: Women’s Health Digital Twin — Data Fabric
svg.desc: Eight digital thread sources (Epic and FHIR, labs and vitals, imaging and procedures, claims and coverage, wearables and remote monitoring, patient-reported outcomes, social determinants and access, history and genomics) stream continuously into a patient digital twin rendered as a volumetric human figure, which maintains state and drives a decision.
